title: Signet Vouch — a private check for your calls
delivery: Same static PWA origin, storage key, word engine and encrypted local vault. Listen/Speak shows two large cards and directly visible own duress. Moving QR carries existing public invitations/device requests and recipient-encrypted replies/copies, with fixed comparison. No account, relay, rendezvous backend, app telemetry or message endpoint. Native NFC/BLE prototypes are separate local installations.
browser_providers: Canvas camera stream and PRF credential stub; real QR decoder and local encryption. Not physical video-call or biometric acceptance.
